shortDescription: Kazakhstan's Ministry of Justice said on Tuesday that enforcement proceedings to recover 2.3 trillion tenge ($5.06 billion) from the NCOC oil consortium had been suspended, Russian news agency Interfax reported.($1 = 454.2700 tenge)
